column1: Luis Arraez stands out as the most reliable option, hitting safely in nearly 75% of games and drawing a favorable home matchup with platoon advantage against Bryse Wilson. Ketel Marte also brings consistency in the cleanup spot, with a strong hit probability and a favorable park boost in Colorado. Gabriel Moreno offers steady recent contact, while Geraldo Perdomo and Corbin Carroll round out the list with solid matchups but slightly less dependable hit rates.
